name: Angular
subtitle: Full application framework
creator: Google (successor to AngularJS, 2010)
description: A batteries-included framework for large applications. Routing, forms, an HTTP client, dependency injection, testing tools and a CLI all come built in, and its reactivity now centers on Signals. New apps are zoneless by default since v21.

languages.youWrite: TypeScript plus HTML templates and CSS or SCSS

concepts.explanation: signal, computed and effect for fine-grained reactivity.
Services are provided and injected by the framework.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript

Signals and zoneless mode improve performance
cons: Steepest learning curve of the frontend options
Low satisfaction: 48% in State of JS 2025
